messages:
People Ops: Quickfire templates for the review packet — 3 tiny pasteables: self-review, manager reply, and promo hint. Keep it scannable (<30s). Drop 👍 if good.

anna: Love concise. Can we add a one-line 'evidence link' slot so reviewers can validate claims quickly?

liam: +1. Also one optional line for scope adjustments (leave, rotation).

People Ops: Added. Here are the pasteables (copy-paste friendly):

SELF-REVIEW (paste)
Impact (1 line): what I shipped + why it mattered
Scope (1 short tag): e.g., enterprise | infra | leave-adjusted
Evidence (one link or metric): <dash|PR|ticket>
Challenge (1 line, optional): blocker + lesson
Ask (1 line): what I need next

MANAGER REPLY (paste)
Amplify: which result to highlight?
Next owner: who owns next step + quarter
Growth: one skill to develop

PROMO HINT (one line)
Promo-signal: {impact|leadership|scope} + one supporting metric/link

zoe: These are perfect for the kickoff email. Suggest changing 'challenge' -> 'challenge + fix' to encourage solutions.

cal: Can leveling-bot remind managers to include `Promo-signal` tag in calibration sheets?

leveling-bot: Will do — I'll auto-flag entries missing `Promo-signal` or `Evidence` during packet ingest.

People Ops: Finalizing and dropping into the review toolkit and the kickoff email. Approve with :white_check_mark:. Thanks!"
